claim_label: Efficacy of free market forces in ensuring AI safety
description: This conflict centers on whether capitalist market dynamics naturally incentivize the creation of safe and fair AI systems. Perspectives range from believing consumer demand filters out harmful products to arguing that profit motives drive companies to cut safety corners or actively exploit users.

instances.assertion: The market naturally filters out harmful AI because customers will not buy unpredictable or biased products.
The market creates a race to the bottom where companies cut safety corners to maximize profit and beat competitors.
The market actively rewards AI that exploits workers and consumers because the real customers are corporations trying to maximize their own profits.
